newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria's ruling Socialists elect new leader.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria's ruling Socialists elect new leader.

text.p: Bulgaria's ruling Socialist Party on Tuesday elected Georgi Parvanov as its leader to replace Zhan Videnov who resigned on Saturday.
His appointment as prime minister must be approved by parliament where the Socialists have a majority.
"This is a sign of the commitment of the Socialist Party to reform," Parvanov told the party's congress after his election.
A showdown between hardliners and reformists in Bulgaria's ruling Socialist party entered its final phase on Monday as congress delegates prepared to vote for a new leader and prime minister.

After Prime Minister Videnov's surprise resignation on Saturday, Interior Minister Nikolai Dobrev led the attack with an outspoken condemnation of the government's failure to halt economic collapse and fight corruption.
But Videnov's supporters fought back, ensuring he was presented again as a candidate for the leadership.
